display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1f2328, #cdd0d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: 8 bpp hardware colours (RGB332): row = upper 3 bits, column = lower 5 bits
